title: Project Starline: Feel like you're there, together
summary: Google's short promo for Project Starline, a booth that shows a life-size, three-dimensional view of the person you are talking to. It presents the technology as a magic window for friends, families and co-workers who are far apart.
why: HN mostly uses it as a reference point for how much better video calls could get, with some skepticism about what the demo leaves out.

quote.text: No headset to wear. No disorientation. You just sit down and you're there with somebody else.
